pullIn.text:
Climbing trains *chest & lats*:
they pull your shoulders forward

exercises.title: Ring Y-raise
exercises.cue:
Arms up in a Y.
Shoulders down, not to your ears.

exercises.title: Ring row, elbows wide
exercises.cue:
Squeeze the shoulder blades.
Pause 1 s at the top.

plan.note: Feet further forward = harder. Pain? See a physio.

outro.title:
Save this for
your next session.
